samples.question: Seven lamps start as shown (filled = ON, ring = OFF), and the red triangle marks the lamp to track. Each orange ROUND card performs one update. In each round, every lamp becomes ON exactly when one of its immediate neighbors was ON at the start of that round (one neighbor ON and the other OFF); otherwise it becomes OFF. All seven lamps update simultaneously. A missing neighbor beyond either end counts as OFF. After all ROUND cards, is the marked lamp ON or OFF? Answer ON or OFF.
